audits.resolution_reason: Default sampler enforces at most one run per (column,color), admitting a global-extremes shortcut. Retain actual-Racket refutation and the exact generated override recipe; hand-valid input and default production support remain distinct.
audits.text:
## 7946249c9684

### A1: Default lessons cannot distinguish contiguous runs from global column/color endpoints

**Finding: reproduced default-distribution shortcut, with an actual generated exact-override witness.** An independent rival keeps only the first and last occurrence of each **(column, color)** pair, merging separate runs of the same color in that column. It matches all four canonical pairs and all 54 default inputs tested. The current source also admits and generates an exact-override example on which Racket preserves two additional endpoints that the rival erases. A smaller validator-accepted example confirms the same distinction. This is a distribution/teaching-domain finding; no incorrect Racket label or measured model-learning failure is claimed. The audited generator, reference, catalog, and approval state were not edited.

### Current source and reference binding

| Identity | Value |
|---|---|
| Generator | `generators/7946249c9684/generator.py` |
| Generator version | `3.2.0` |
| Generator SHA-256 | `0e39b781378bcd3b94bf4bceb407dc9fc1528c0e4fada003a4a1512c0d3bdf6f` |
| Declared and executed rule ID | `ab25d2969132` |
| Exact canonical rule-source SHA-256 | `4c7bac1a3e6fd8338762e2321dc55e02d36fab42aafe18b39eb1e4be3ed0f3f6` |
| Whitespace-normalized rule-source SHA-256 | `ab25d2969132fa79e24c65a4fc6d3249712e471e24edc8174d86bdad326c3259` |
| Executed callable SHA-256, reported by the supported apply API | `5447f2df8bad25e7bb4273d716f17117508d151b988ae251daa9bc0c33c167a8` |

The source hash matches the current `evidence/review_index.json`. That index contains no active audit rows and records an existing reviewer-reported approval decision. The existing notes and retained `current-shortcut.json` were read as leads. Their prior battery, override, and lesson counts were not treated as measurements from this audit. Those earlier checks address four declared rivals; the new `column_color_extremes` rival is absent from all three current rival dictionaries. No solve files or private solve data were opened.

### Concrete generated witness

Reproduce with the unchanged current generator:

```python
generate(
    seed=1,
    sample_index=0,
    difficulty="medium",
    grid_w=7,
    n_runs=8,
    palette_size=3,
)
```

`grid_h` is not overridden and resolves to `7`. The exact observed axes are `grid_h=7`, `grid_w=7`, `n_runs=8`, and `palette_size=3`. The actual validator returns `[]`. This is a generated member of the supported exact-override domain, not a hand-only or default-generated claim. Both seeds attempted in the discovery search, `0` and `1`, are retained; seed `1` was the first separating draw.

The full input is retained as batch index `59` in [input.json](checks/audit/7946249c9684/input.json) and in [counterexamples.json](checks/audit/7946249c9684/counterexamples.json). In zero-based column `6`, color `6` occupies rows `0..1` and `3..6`, with background at row `2`.

The true transformation treats these as separate maximal same-color runs and preserves endpoints at rows `0`, `1`, `3`, and `6`. The rival merges the occurrences and preserves only rows `0` and `6`. Actual Racket and rival outputs differ at exactly:

| Zero-based cell | Racket | Rival |
|---|---:|---:|
| `(1, 6)` | 6 | 0 |
| `(3, 6)` | 6 | 0 |

A second, constructed example uses the minimum admitted dimensions `6x7`, three runs, and two colors: color `1` occupies column `1`, rows `0,1,3,4,5`; color `2` occupies column `4`, rows `1,2,3`; all other cells are `0`. It passes `self_check`. Racket and the rival differ exactly at `(1,1)` and `(3,1)`, where Racket returns `1` and the rival returns `0`. Its seed and sample index are `null`; it is explicitly classified as a constructed domain witness at batch index `60`.

### Why every default construction hides this distinction

The source argument is stronger than extrapolation from the 54 tested inputs:

- `_canonical_runs` uses three distinct columns, so each `(column, color)` appears in one run.
- `_boundary_contact_runs` uses two runs in its primary column, but explicitly assigns them different colors from a distinct palette. Its bridge is in a different column, and each extra run receives a previously unused column.
- `_separated_stack_runs` places two separated runs in its stack column, but again assigns different colors to the top and bottom runs. Its bridge and extras use different columns.
- `generate` chooses only these three constructors when all exact-axis overrides are absent or `None`.

Consequently, every successful default input has at most one maximal run per `(column, color)`. On that support, global column/color extrema and maximal-run endpoints are identical. Reusing a color in a different column refutes the existing `global_color_extremes` rival, but does not refute this one because it groups by column as well as color.

The exact-override witness reaches `_generic_sparse_runs`: eight runs on seven columns force one column to be used twice, and the retained seed assigns the same color to both separated runs. Thus the distinction is already meaningful inside the advertised controls and validator domain; it is simply missing from ordinary default lessons. This audit does not claim that the rival matches every possible overridden draw.

### Fresh measurements

The single Racket batch contains 61 distinct inputs. Default samples are unfiltered actual `generate` calls: 18 per difficulty, `sample_index=i` for `i=0..17`, and `seed=1000+100*band_index+i`, with `band_index=0,1,2` for easy, medium, and hard. Every band includes six calls to each scheduled profile. The separate exact-override search retains both tested seeds. There was no generation rejection or sample filtering.

| Check | Newly measured result |
|---|---:|
| Validator accepts batch inputs | 61/61 |
| Distinct inputs | 61/61 |
| Racket applications succeed | 61/61; zero per-input errors |
| Independent local-neighbor endpoint implementation agrees with Racket | 61/61 |
| Racket agrees with stored canonical labels | 4/4 |
| New rival agrees with canonical labels | 4/4 |
| New rival agrees with generated defaults | 54/54, including 18/18 per band |
| New rival agrees with two retained exact-override draws | 1/2 |
| New rival disagrees with generated exact-override witness | 1/1 |
| New rival disagrees with constructed accepted witness | 1/1 |

The independent output check tests each cell's immediate vertical neighbors and imports no generator run/output helper. The rival groups raw input cells directly by `(column, color)`. Neither implementation supplies authority labels.

### Reproduction and retained evidence

Run from the packet's `WORK` directory:

```bash
.venv-review/bin/python checks/audit/7946249c9684/probe.py prepare --repo repo
.venv-review/bin/python checks/audit/7946249c9684/probe.py reference --repo repo
.venv-review/bin/python checks/audit/7946249c9684/probe.py summarize --repo repo
```

The reference step executed this supported command with actual working directory `/workspace/scratch/df8d9659f825/review/WORK` and effective wrapper working directory `/workspace/scratch/df8d9659f825/review/WORK/repo`:

```bash
/workspace/scratch/df8d9659f825/review/WORK/.venv-review/bin/python run_with_racket.py /workspace/scratch/df8d9659f825/review/WORK/.venv-review/bin/python -m arcpuzzles apply 7946249c9684 --input ../checks/audit/7946249c9684/input.json --out ../checks/audit/7946249c9684/racket.json
```

All three probe invocations and the supported reference subprocess exited `0`. Exact argument arrays, actual working directories, elapsed times, output streams, and statuses are retained in [verification_commands.json](checks/audit/7946249c9684/verification_commands.json). [sampling.json](checks/audit/7946249c9684/sampling.json) contains source identity, seeds, indices, overrides, observed axes, and run facts for every input. [racket.json](checks/audit/7946249c9684/racket.json), [rival.json](checks/audit/7946249c9684/rival.json), and [summary.json](checks/audit/7946249c9684/summary.json) retain complete labels and comparisons. [probe.py](checks/audit/7946249c9684/probe.py) accepts an explicit checkout path for preparation and comparison; its convenience reference mode expects the documented portable `WORK` layout.

### Suggested disposition and limits

Retain as an actionable default-distribution finding. A future repair can add default examples with two separated runs of the same color in one column, register this independent rival, and check that complete lessons and relevant query rotations retain separating demonstrations while honoring exact run/palette controls. This audit makes no source repair or approval change.

This was a focused adversarial audit: no full battery, production-lesson census, model evaluation, or universal-induction claim. The source proof identifies the default support restriction; the actual Racket batch verifies the reported current-source cases. Existing measurements against the four previously declared rivals remain valid within their stated scope.
